meta.title: Is Ba Na Hills Worth It? A Full Day Beyond the Golden Bridge  🇻🇳
meta.description:
Is Ba Na Hills worth a full day? I travelled from Hoi An to explore the complete experience beyond Vietnam's famous Golden Bridge: the cable cars, Le Jardin d'Amour, the mountaintop spiritual area, French Village, live entertainment, food, stores and the Alpine Coaster that became my favourite attraction of the day.
